reading.zh: 从左上角「应用组装与启动」开始看：它把下面这些部件一个个建起来。箭头指向谁，就表示谁被用到了；箭头上的字说明用到了什么。想看某一块里面是什么，点它。
reading.en: Start at “Application Assembly & Boot” in the top left: it builds the parts below it one by one. An arrow points at whatever is being used, and the words on it say what for. Click any box to look inside.
